notes.title: Paradise of Desire Music DLC is available for free!
notes.content:
Free entry, download can listen
It contains six BGMS of different styles and one theme song
1. The beginning
2. Stare at girls
3. Endless battle
4. Meet a girl
5. Truth and Confession
6. Chase
7. Theme Song (Dark World)
